notes: Total 18 (hard). Four competencies, each verified on hidden inputs. The sequence must be implemented identically under two independent runtimes (Python + safe Rust), where the Rust source is additionally statically scanned for zero unsafe/FFI/ABI constructs, so small off-by-one or recurrence errors show up as cross-runtime disagreement (quantitative_correctness=3, hidden_case_generalization=3). The wasm deliverable must satisfy an exact ABI: boot() fills 256 bytes of linear memory from a documented formula, producer() returns a dynamic offset in [0,239], consumer() reads exactly 16 bytes at that offset and returns their sum; the verifier reads the same 16 bytes host-side and compares byte-for-byte and against the integer (dependent_stages=2, reasoning_depth=2, quantitative=3) — wrong length/offset silently break the sum on hidden seeds. The grpc toolchain must be importable system-wide and its code generator must produce importable bindings from an unseen hidden proto (hidden_case_generalization). Difficulty is genuinely distributed across tools (system apt installs, pip toolchain, clang wasm32, rustc, wasmtime host ABI, grpc_tools.protoc) and the exact-output byte/integer checks, not from length alone. The two hard-floor competencies (sequence-in-two-runtimes, safe Rust with zero unsafe) are met head-on; no probe is documented.
